versions.short: The resolution provides for consideration of several measures in Congress. These include a bill to establish a National Fraud Enforcement Division at the Department of Justice, and a bill to improve information-sharing between federal law enforcement and state agencies to detect, investigate, and prosecute fraud in certain federal programs while protecting individual privacy. It also covers two joint resolutions that disapprove Environmental Protection Agency rules on California pollution standards for nonroad engines, ocean-going vessels at berth, and commercial harbor craft. Finally, it provides for consideration of Senate amendments to a bill allowing early childhood educators to take the educator expense deduction.
